name: Nishulk Swasthya Jaanch Yojana - Uttarakhand
benefit: Free diagnostic tests are provided at district hospitals, sub-district hospitals, community health centres, urban primary health centres, and primary health centres. Under the scheme, a total of 266 tests are available completely free of charge.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary can avail free health check-ups after registering at any government hospital in the state.
